verdict.rationale: GitHub's own docs confirm fine-grained personal access tokens exist and that you grant each one a specific set of permissions defining what resources it can access via the API. The `X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions` header shows which permissions an endpoint requires. The evidence does not show tokens being restricted to specific repositories or given an expiry date, which are two of the story's three elements. Missing for 10: documented per-repository scoping of tokens, documented token expiry dates, independent or hands-on corroboration.
